scenario_description:
Objective: Finish dyeing a small set of fabric conversation tokens for tomorrow evening’s silent-dinner table.
Emerging Need: The dye-studio attempt has already begun, then the same wet-bench process stops when Bay 2’s safety interlock locks the rinse and heat controls.
Decision Context: Stored studio notes identify the no-cost reset route, cutoff, and limits on avoiding paid disposal or restart commitments.
Consequence: Timely help could let the interrupted dye batch resume before the tokens must dry; after the reset window closes, the intended finished set cannot be ready.

parameter.title: Silent dinner fabric-token tying
parameter.description: Bring the dyed fabric conversation tokens and tie them onto the table cards before friends arrive.
Two-hour dye bench for fabric conversation tokens

parameter.content: At the dye studio now. First two token strips are in the indigo rinse, and the folded stack is clipped beside Bay 2 so I can finish the rest before drying time.

parameter.subject: Bay 2 safety interlock on receipt DS-431
parameter.body: The Bay 2 hood sensor tripped at 4:39 PM. Heat and rinse controls for the active wet-bench slot are locked, and projects on that bench cannot continue until a staff reset clears the interlock.

parameter.subject: Evening reset queue closed for Bay 2
parameter.body: The same-day reset queue for Bay 2 is closed. Wet-bench projects still paused after the cutoff will be bagged for unfinished pickup during tomorrow’s desk hours, with no further dye or rinse access tonight.
